subject: SignalForge distribution + weights access — next steps
content:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Costa <ana@signalforge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SignalForge distribution + weights access — next steps

Ana —

Great to meet on Friday. Thanks again for walking us through SignalForge v2. The team is excited about the model family and the performance trade-offs you described.

Per our discussion, next things we need to align on to move toward a publisher distribution agreement:

- We need a short doc describing the permissible redistributions and downstream uses of the model weights (what you call "weights access policy").
- A standard CLA/redistribution addendum (we can share our draft) and IP/attribution requirements.
- Operational details: hosted artifact locations, checksums, and a verification flow we can include in partner onboarding.
- Any embargo windows or promotional coordination you want for launch.

If you can share a brief weights policy draft, our legal and platform teams will review and propose concrete redlines. Monica (cc'd) is our alliances lead and will own the contract side.

Two asks from us to keep momentum:
1) Share the weights access policy doc, even a one-pager, by end of week.
2) A time for a 30-min legal/engineering sync next week (Mon/Tue preferred).

Attachments: none on my side right now.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

Hi Rachel + Monica —

Thanks for the clear summary. We're aligned on the ask. Attaching an internal "weights access policy" one-pager and our standard distributor checklist for your review. High level:

- We publish full fp16 weights for research and enterprise redistribution under a distributor addendum.
- Restricted model variants (quantized/edge) are on a separate commercial path.
- Attribution and model card must accompany any distributed weights.

I attached the two items (see list below). We prefer an initial 30-day review window from signature to allow for a joint QA step before publishing.

Best,
Ana
Ana Costa
Head of Partnerships | SignalForge
ana@signalforge.ai | +1 646 555 0199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Costa <ana@signalforge.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:20:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SignalForge distribution + weights access — next steps

Ana — thanks for the quick turnaround and the one-pager. I pulled legal and infra into a quick pass and included initial notes inline (see attached).

Summary of Redwood positions and suggested edits (high level):

- We can support distribution of fp16 weights under a distributor addendum tied to a CLA. Our standard clause requires:
  * explicit downstream redistribution rights for customers with a non-commercial/limited commercial carve depending on SignalForge's preference,
  * attribution language in both repos and direct downloads,
  * a mechanism for revoking distribution in case of license violation.
- Operational/verification asks:
  * Hosted artifact MUST include a signed checksum and a short provenance file (model card + build metadata).
  * For our hosted endpoint / Dedicated product we need a responsibility matrix for security scanning and a timeline for vulnerability updates.
- Embargo and launch: a 30-day joint QA window is workable. We propose a joint announcement cadence and co-branded launch doc.

I've attached our draft CLA addendum (redwood_draft_cla.docx) and inline comments in SignalForge_Dist_Terms_v1.pdf (attachment stub). Dev, can your team confirm feasibility for signed checksum ingestion and the verification hook?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Wed 13 Apr 2027 at 10:00 PT to walk the redlines together. If that works for you, Ana, I'll send a calendar invite and link.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0190

Attachments: redwood_draft_cla.docx (attachment), SignalForge_Dist_Terms_v1.pdf (attachment stub)

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 16:04:03 -0400
Subject: Re: SignalForge distribution + weights access — next steps

Monica / Rachel —

Wed 13 Apr 10:00 PT works for me. Appreciate the detailed redlines — most of those sound reasonable. A couple quick clarifications before the call:

- Revocation: we prefer a remediation-first flow (notice, 7-day remediation window, then revocation) rather than immediate takedown. Is that acceptable?
- Verification hook: we can publish checksums and a provenance JSON at a signed S3 URL. Will your infra consume a signed URL + checksum and perform automated verification?

I'll review the CLA draft prior to the call and prepare a redline. Sending an invite shortly for 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET.

See you on the call,
Ana
Ana Costa

ana@signalforge.ai
